title: Struggling with the LGBT issue?
excerpt: For those Christians sincerely struggling to come to terms with LGBT identity, equality, and inclusion, you couldn’t ask for a better guide and mentor than my South African friend Graeme. Let me introduce you to him here. Here’s his recommended reading list.
